rows.sql: select value as paying_users from metrics_paying_users_snapshots order by snapshot_date desc limit 1;
select sum(value) as signups from metric_new_users where metric_time >= '2026-02-01' and metric_time <= '2026-02-28'

select sum(billed_amount) as total_annual_billed
from fct_subscriptions
where plan = 'annual'; select count(*) as count_annual, sum(billed_amount) as total_annual_billed
from fct_subscriptions
where plan = 'annual';

select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_count
from dim_users u
join fct_subscriptions s on u.user_id = s.user_id
where u.signup_date >= '2026-07-01'
  and u.signup_date < '2026-08-01'
  and s.plan ilike '%annual%'
  and (s.ended_date is null or s.ended_date >= '2026-07-01');
select count(*) as fitness_habits from dim_habits where category = 'fitness';

select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_user
where signup_date >= '2026-04-01' and signup_date <= '2026-04-30'; select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_users
where signup_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-04-30';
select metric_time::text as month, value from metrics_active_users_month where metric_time >= '2026-05-01' and metric_time < '2026-06-01' and user__is_internal = 'false' order by metric_time;

select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_user
where signup_date >= '2026-03-01' and signup_date <= '2026-03-31'; select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_users
where signup_date >= '2026-03-01' and signup_date <= '2026-03-31';

select count(*) as subscriptions_started_march_2026
from fct_subscription_term st
join dim_users u on st.user_id = u.user_id
where st.started_date >= date '2026-03-01'
  and st.started_date <= date '2026-03-31'
  and not u.is_internal;

select sum(billed_amount) as total_billed_annual
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u on t.user_id = u.user_id
where t.plan = 'annual' and not u.is_internal;

select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_signed_in_july
from dim_users u
join fct_subscription_term s on u.user_id = s.user_id
where u.is_internal = false
  and u.signup_date between '2026-07-01' and '2026-07-31'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and s.started_date <= '2026-07-31' -- term started on or before end of july
  and (s.ended_date is null or s.ended_date >= '2026-07-01')
;
